description: This file defines a class 'VersionGrainsSiloBuilderConfigurator' that implements the 'IHostConfigurator' interface to configure an Orleans silo in a test environment. It sets configuration options such as silo count, messaging options, versioning strategies, and placement director via dependency injection.

classes.name: VersionGrainsSiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Implements IHostConfigurator to configure Orleans silo for testing, including versioning and placement strategies.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the host builder by setting silo options, messaging options, versioning strategies, and placement director.

methods.name: ConfigureServices
methods.description: Registers the VersionAwarePlacementStrategy and VersionAwarePlacementDirector in the service collection.
